task.title: Share verified workflow advancement preflight
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/783 by removing duplicated verified-advance preparation while preserving every public validation, conflict, and event contract.
acceptance_criteria: Share exact run, transition, authored gate, attributed task, and gate-set preparation across both verified advancement paths.
Preserve each path's original validation order, terminal-target rule, task active rule, append shape, and public errors.
Centralize workflow revision conflict classification without weakening task evidence re-evaluation.
Introduce no public API, event schema, or behavior change.

attempts.diagnostic: Existing workflow unit and integration tests covered success, rejection, evidence-race, terminal-race, and workflow-race behavior for both paths.
attempts.patch: Ran the focused workflow suites as the behavior-preservation baseline before changing private structure.

attempts.diagnostic: The two operations duplicated phase-relative preparation but intentionally differed in task state timing and append semantics.
attempts.patch: Added a private prepared value and small helpers for run and gate resolution, task loading, passed-evidence checks, and workflow conflict classification while retaining path-specific checks.

attempts.summary: Preserved a newly discovered liveness defect as explicit follow-up.
attempts.diagnostic: Substantive review found both shared retry loops could remain synchronous forever under continuous task stream writes.
attempts.patch: Did not hide the finding inside a nominal refactor; recorded bounded issue 785 for a typed retry limit, verified unchanged behavior, and merged only after the review thread was resolved.

outcome.summary: Both verified workflow advancement paths now share auditable private preparation and conflict handling while preserving their distinct atomicity and lifecycle contracts; the discovered retry-liveness defect became explicit follow-up work.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel --test workflow_run_store
nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel workflow::tests

lessons: For refactors, characterize externally visible behavior before extraction instead of manufacturing a failing behavior test.
Share phase-relative preparation while leaving materially different append and lifecycle policy visible at each call site.
Centralizing conflict classification makes cross-path concurrency fixes less likely to drift.
A valid review finding outside a behavior-preserving refactor should become a concrete bounded issue, not be ignored or silently broaden scope.
